item.title: For centuries massive meals amazed visitors to Korea (2019)
Despite what's happening in the USA, renewables are winning globally
item.description:
📝 Wind and solar power are meeting and even exceeding a global rise in energy demand. ” This year marks the first time that renewable energy sources have outpowered coal in the global energy mix. That US-driven dip drags down the agency’s global projections for renewable energy growth by 5 percent.
